messages.subject: Brightwater / Pennine Mutual — responding mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Amelia,

Our responding redline (v3, tracked) is attached. In summary: clause 11.3 cap at 125% of charges paid in the preceding 12 months (up from our 100%, but not 200%); clause 11.4 super-cap fixed at £3,000,000 for data-protection and confidentiality breaches — we cannot agree uncapped liability; clause 8.3 retained with tightened anonymisation wording; and clause 13.2 held at 90 days' notice after year two. We think this is a fair landing and hope we can finalise on this basis.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
